payload.summary: Structured rights metadata is locally reviewed/tested; source permission evidence and integration remain
payload.detail:
CURRENT EXECUTION 24 October 2026: Structured optional rights fields, evidence/date validation and attestation invalidation are locally implemented. Independent specialist review found a malformed-date coercion bug; the parent reproduced it, fixed it with a string/null guard, added the exact malformed object regression and obtained a clear correction review. Post-correction focused run passed 114 tests across six files. Existing 188 source records and 95 attestations remain unchanged. Remaining: integration and actual evidence-backed per-source rights review/population. No clinical/legal permission, rank change or publication is granted.

HISTORICAL DETAIL (superseded where corrected above): LOCAL IMPLEMENTATION 24 October 2026: optional rights record in acquisition-ledger.ts supports unknown/restricted/documented, licence, HTTPS terms evidence, checked date and notes. Omission stays unknown; documented terms confer no access, ingestion, publication, ranking or clinical approval. Tests cover malformed inputs, evidence links/dates, unchanged classification and stale attestations after edits. Existing source data and signatures were not rewritten. Remaining: independent review, integration and actual evidence-backed per-source rights review/population; do not fill permissions from assumptions.
